evaluation: Matched fixed-proposal comparison of the action policy gate with and without the gate, using the real validator and side-effect-free recovery eligibility assessment.
proposal_source: The 36 fixed, handcrafted proposal records from policy-gate V1; candidate and incident identities and valid control parameters are explicitly bound for both arms.
safety_boundary: RecoveryEngine.recover() is never called. The real validator may apply controlled repairs inside its temporary workspace and trains/evaluates a model for data-quality validation. The experiment does not create recovered pipeline models or metrics, execute arbitrary code, install packages, or make LLM/provider requests.
interpretation_limit: This is a matched decision-level ablation on handcrafted proposals, not a live LLM-generation experiment or a measure of end-to-end recovery success or general security.
